get.description:
Complete the flow: mint a JWT for the resolved actor and return to the SPA.

The token travels in the URL *fragment* (``#/oauth/callback?token=…``) so it
never reaches the server, logs, or the Referer header. The dashboard reads
the fragment on load and persists the token.

Begin the OAuth flow: redirect the browser to the provider.

``slug`` names the workspace to log in to. A first-time identity may only
join a *secured* workspace with an ``invite`` (from
``POST /workspaces/{slug}/actors/{actor_id}/oauth-invite``); open workspaces
allow self-join while ``ERID_ALLOW_OPEN_WORKSPACES`` is on. Requires the
provider to be configured (``ERID_OAUTH_<PROVIDER>_*``) and
``ERID_SESSION_SECRET`` to be set.

List every workspace (slug, name, secured flag).

Unauthenticated by default: principals are per-workspace, a directory is
needed to discover workspaces, and only non-secret metadata is exposed. With
``ERID_PUBLIC_WORKSPACE_DIRECTORY=0`` it needs the operator's admin token.

schema.title: Response List Workspaces Api Workspaces Get

post.description:
Create a workspace and return its API key (shown only here; never re-disclosed).

Requires ``X-Admin-Token`` when ``ERID_ADMIN_TOKEN`` is configured.

delete.description: Delete an entire workspace and everything in it (owner only).

get.description: List actors in the workspace (names, roles, status — never keys).

schema.title: Response List Actors Api Workspaces  Slug  Actors Get

post.description: Mint a new actor with its own API key (shown only here; stored hashed).

delete.description: Revoke an actor (its keys, tokens and grants stop working).

post.description:
Invite a person to log in as an existing actor via Google/GitHub (admin only).

Create the actor first (``POST /workspaces/{slug}/actors``) with the role it
should have, then mint an invite for it. The first OAuth login carrying the
invite links that provider account to the actor; afterwards the invite is
spent. Optionally pin ``email`` so only an account with that verified email
can redeem it.

get.description:
The workspace's audit trail, newest first (admins only).

Provisioning, claiming, key rotation, actor changes, token issuance and
refusals, OAuth logins and invites, and rejected credentials.
